identifiability.reason: Each disconnected driver/constructor component has an arbitrary additive offset; a ridge solution would impose a prior, not identify ability.

measurement: Condition-matched race pace of the observed driver/car combination. Lower is faster relative to the matched event samples; not a win probability or separated ability score.

coverage.note: Equal weight per eligible GP; at least 10 condition-matched laps per GP.
